The default Dashboards installation on each OpenSearch Service domain has some additional
features:
• User interfaces for the various OpenSearch plugins
• Tenants
• Reports
Use the Reporting menu to generate on-demand CSV reports from the Discover page and PDF or
PNG reports of dashboards or visualizations. CSV reports have a 10,000 row limit.
• Gantt charts
• Notebooks
Additional features
